jobs.description: <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. The team partners closely with the engineering, product, finance, and partnership groups to manage and understand Stripe’s network costs.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our work is core to Stripe’s business,&nbsp; as Technical Operations roles in Payments are a dynamic and key component of Stripe's success.
